product_metadata.title: Houseables Airtight Food Containers, Sugar Storage, 175 Oz, Set of 2, Flour Canisters, Clear Plastic, BPA Free, w/Lock Lid, Chalk Marker, Labels, Scoop, Cereal Keeper, Dispenser, Kitchen, Pantry Box
features: KEEP FOOD AIRTIGHT AND SAFE: Whenever you open a new box of cookies, there is always the chance that the inner plastic bag will leak in some air and turn your favorite dessert stale. With these food storage containers, you can always be sure that your food will last its expected duration.

ALL THE BENEFITS: By keeping dry food in our airtight storage containers, you lessen the chance of inviting unwanted bugs or inducing premature decomposition. Moisture will be kept out and all the flavors will be kept in.

NO HARM TO YOU: Aside from protecting your foods from external forces, these containers were constructed from BPA-free, food-grade, and non-toxic plastic so you can be entirely aware of the foods that you are putting into your system.

ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES: Not only can these food storage containers house your family’s favorite snacks, but it can also store other dry foods. Flour, nuts, coffee, rice, and pet food are some other examples of foods that could benefit from these bins. Use the included labels and chalk marker to determine which food is in which container.

A SUITABLE SIZE: These food storage containers are the perfect size to fit into your pantry or on your kitchen counter. You can get extremely organized in a flash and take up very little space if you stack them on top of each other.
